description: WUMPOD is a global dataset of urban morphological parameters at 500 m resolution, prepared for urban climate modelling and easy use in the WRF model. It was published on Zenodo on 2 January 2024 by Pratiman Patel and Matthias Roth of the National University of Singapore. Parameters include mean, standard deviation and area-weighted building height, plan and surface area fractions, frontal aspect ratios in four directions, complete aspect ratio, height-to-width ratio, the distribution of building heights in 5 m bands up to 75 m, roughness length and displacement height by several methods, urban fraction from WorldCover 2021 and the missing building fraction. Coverage: global urban areas. Access: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs per parameter and a 3.8 GB WRF-WPS archive on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: parameters depend on the underlying building data, and a missing building fraction flags gaps. Simulation uses: urban canopy inputs for heat, wind and air quality models worldwide. Related records: GLAMOUR and the Sydney urban form data.
